content: The results are provided in Table TABREF30. In about $52\%$ of the cases annotators marked translations as having equal quality. Among the cases where one of the translations was marked better than the other, the DocRepair translation was marked better in $73\%$ of the cases. This shows a strong preference of the annotators for corrected translations over the baseline ones.
